issue.title: Rust bead store multi-get: statuses-for-ids binding to replace the list_issues full hydration in bead_statuses_for_project
issue.description: Store-side multi-get for bead statuses; details in the proposal field.

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add a store-side multi-get to the sase-core bead store — e.g. a `bead_statuses_for_ids` (or general `bead_show_many`) binding — and adopt it in `bead_statuses_for_project` (src/sase/bead/store_locator.py).

Today the Rust `bead_show` binding is single-id only, so phase sase-wn.8, when it removed the per-bead show() N+1 from the prompt-panel wait-bead header, had to fall back to hydrating EVERY issue in the store through one `list_issues` call and filtering in Python (src/sase/bead/store_locator.py:93-139). That is one query instead of N, but it still deserializes the whole store to answer a handful of ids; a store-side statuses-for-ids would be cheaper on large stores.

Scope: sase-core store API + wire + binding, then swap the Python fallback in `bead_statuses_for_project` to use it (keeping the list_issues path as fallback for older cores per the floor policy). This crosses the Rust core boundary, so the sase-core repo work comes first.

Proposed by epic phase bead sase-wn.8 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #3, 2026-09-04 15:36 EDT); routed here by the sase-wn land agent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Out of scope for epic sase-wn: that epic's ace-io-hygiene phase only needed to eliminate the N+1 subprocess/show pattern for idle-CPU purposes, which the single list_issues query already achieves within its budget. Adding a new sase-core store API, wire surface, and binding is new backend capability work, not idle-CPU remediation, and the epic explicitly noted the boundary and kept the batch in Python per its plan ("if the binding offers no multi-get, note the boundary and keep the batch in Python").

payload.entry: Superseded by sase-1h8.12 (read-model-queries, 446f1833de + sase-core d2a56b4c). Verified by the sase-1h8 land agent on master 563f046a85. The core bead_statuses_for_ids multi-get answers from read-model indexes, and bead_statuses_for_project (src/sase/bead/store_locator.py) calls bead_read_facade.statuses_for_ids instead of hydrating list_issues. On the live store, statuses_for_ids matches a plain-replay copy (87 ms cached vs 358 ms replay). The facade's older-core list_issues fallback stays until the sase-core-rs floor includes the binding; its retirement is filed as sase-1iy.
